rationale: The objective is ttft_ms, which times only the prefill forward over the frozen 256-token prompt plus argmax up to the explicit first-token synchronize (qwen_inference.py:16-24); decode is timed after that boundary, so the 31 single-token decode calls (681 ms of the 705 ms end-to-end baseline) are not where this project's metric is decided. The editable unit that owns the entire prefill compute is the Qwen3Model forward boundary: verified signatures show one prefill-shaped call (2441f10600ba127de5cb753c, input_ids [1,256], past_key_values=None) and one decode-shaped call (e7df98b905ed8aa688d5227a, input_ids [1,1], DynamicCache, 31 invocations) on the same target 'model.model', so any replacement installed at this module boundary necessarily receives both call families and must own both behaviors; the two phase groups therefore need one another and are selected jointly. Measured evidence for the opportunity: clean original baseline ttft_ms=24.611 (project.json). The separately collected nsys diagnostic (observations/current/nsys-9ed9145c.json, kernel-identity resolved, perturbed host side) shows the prefill+argmax window is 2146 kernels with 21.34 ms GPU busy versus a clean wall of 24.6 ms, i.e. roughly 3 ms of exposed host-dispatch time; within that busy time only ~16 ms is GEMM (ampere_bf16/cutlass/gemv, matching the 16.47 ms aten::linear prefill family diagnostic) while ~5.3 ms is non-GEMM elementwise/reduce/cat/copy work: 73 Qwen3RMSNorm executions per prefill, each 7 eager aten ops (to fp32, pow, mean, rsqrt, mul, cast, mul-weight; verified in transformers 5.16.1 source), per-forward rotary cos/sin recomputation (bmm outer product, cat, cos, sin in fp32), rope rotate_half, residual adds, SiLU-gated mul and KV cache appends (aten::cat 2306-call decode family plus 109 prefill calls). python_runtime cProfile (perturbed, qualitative) confirms the host cost is eager per-op dispatch through this boundary's subtree: 17,472 nn.Module __call__ dispatches per run (~546 per forward) with RMSNorm forward, Tensor.to, apply_rotary_pos_emb, mean and cat as the top self-time sites inside Qwen3Model.forward. A rewrite localized to this one boundary can replace the whole eager layer-stack execution for the [1,256] signature while delegating the [1,1] DynamicCache signature to the parent reference, so decode semantics (cache update, continuous execution, reset) are preserved by passthrough and the secondary decode_tokens_per_second goal is untouched. The ForCausalLM boundary above (groups e0861b46dbeeb562f67f/3e293c00b1fb98fbe29f) and the adapter-level argmax stay original and are not declared affected; nested prefill children (DecoderLayer/MLP/Attention/linear/norm calls) execute as part of this boundary's subtree rather than as separately edited sites.
hypothesis: Replacing Qwen3Model.forward with a single implementation that (a) on the prefill signature [1,256], past_key_values=None, use_cache=True executes the 36-layer stack as one compiled/fused region - fusing the RMSNorm chains, residual adds, rotary application and cache-append elementwise work (and optionally consolidating the gate/up and q/k/v projections that share an input into single GEMMs), with lazy compile during the unmeasured warmup lifecycle - and (b) on decode-shaped inputs calls the parent reference unchanged, will reduce ttft_ms by recovering the ~3 ms of exposed dispatch overhead and roughly 2-3 ms of the ~5.3 ms non-GEMM busy time, while the ~16 ms GEMM floor limits the best case: a testable target of about 18-21 ms versus the 24.61 ms baseline (15-25%). Exact greedy tokens and logits closeness should be preserved because the teacher-forced replay in observe() runs through the same replaced boundary (self-consistent numerics within the 0.02 tolerances), and decode throughput should be unchanged by passthrough. This expected benefit is a hypothesis to be measured, not a guaranteed gain: the nsys and cProfile collectors perturb host timing, so the true clean-run exposed overhead may be smaller than in the diagnostic window, and per-invocation allocator behavior (peak_allocated_bytes is recorded but not an objective) plus phase-guard dispatch behavior of the legacy binding backend will be checked on the measured worker rather than assumed.
